column1: #build label(entrance_drawbridge) start(1; 1) message(Build across your entrance corridor. The bridge raises to the north to seal the passage. Place the lever within reach and link it to the bridge after building.)
tags: build, bridge, drawbridge, defense, starter

description: A raising drawbridge to seal your fort entrance. The bridge tokens are directional: gw raises the span to the north so it walls off the corridor behind it when pulled. Build a lever within walking distance and link it to the bridge to raise and lower the gate. Widen or lengthen the bridge by painting a larger gw block; Quickfort builds one bridge per contiguous same-type area.
